tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// slob dpon padma ka ra dang bla ma dbyer med du sgrub pa'i thabs thar lam nying khu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru padma ka rā ya/ 'dir slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas dang dbyer med pa'i lam zab nyams su len par 'dod pas bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis 'dug ste/ na mo/ bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku// dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la// bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du// bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas ni// gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis// 'gro ba bsgral bar dam bca'o// zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ rang nyid gnas pa'i sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams chen por gsal ba'i mdun phyogs su yid bzhin gyi rgya mtsho chen po sngo zhing dwangs la yangs shing dri ma med pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs padma'i sdong po lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba/ de'i dbus su rang gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas ā tsārya lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhi zhing khro la 'dzum zhing yid du 'ong ba'i spyan nyi zla ltar 'khyil ba/ zhal nas gsang sngags zab mo'i sgra sgrogs pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na mtshan ldan gyi ka pā la 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga yod pa/ dbu skra gnag cig snum pa'i lcang lo 'phyang ba/ dbu la sha ba'i mnyen zhu gsol ba/ de la rgod kyi rtse rgyal btsugs pa/ dngul dkar gyi me long dang*/

gser gyi nyi zla dang rdo rje'i tog gis mtshan pa/ dar chen sna lnga'i phod kyis brgyan pa/ sku la rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang gos mthing nag dar gyi phod ka gsol ba/ de'i steng du chos gos ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan dmar po la gser gyi pa tra ris yod pa mnabs pa/ de'i phyir khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i za ber smug khra gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung mdzad pa/ 'khor du rig 'dzin brgyud pa dang sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs pa/ me tog gi char 'bebs shing rol mo'i sgra sgrogs pa/ snang srid thams cad bkrag dang mdangs su me re ba/ 'ja' dang 'od du khyil le ba cig bsam/ bla ma de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros pas nub phyogs o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang rnga yab dpal ri'i rtse mo/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i gnas mchog dang phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas slob dpon chen po 'khor dang bcas pa kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun gyi de nyid la thim/ de dag gis bdag la dgyes pa'i spyan gyis gzigs/ brtse ba'i thugs rjes dgongs/ 'dzum pa'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu dang bu mo khyed rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las ngas sgrol/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la ngas 'god/ 'di phyi bar do'i skyabs gnas ngas byed/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad ngas stsol zhes gsung lhang lhang yod par bsams la/ rang gi lus dang longs spyod ltos med du phul/ snying gi dkyil nang gi khong nas mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos glo snying brang gsum spyi bo mthil bzhi gtad nas kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par gsol ba 'di ltar gdab ste/ e ma ho/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams na// 'od dpag med pa chos sku bde ba che// lho phyogs po ta la yi ri bo'i spor// spyan ras gzigs dbang longs sku thugs rje can// o rgyan rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang na// padma 'byung gnas grub dbang sprul ba'i sku// da lta bod yul kha ba can ljongs na// bka' drin mnyam med drin chen chos kyi rje// sku gsum dbyer med bla ma rin po che// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dang*// snyigs dus nyam thag bod yul skye rgu'i tshogs// khyad par bdag dang bdag la ltos pa rnams// brtse chen thugs rje'i spyan gyis dbyings nas gzigs// rgyal dbang khyod gsung bslu med rdo rje'i gsung*// dad ldan mi re'i mdun du pad 'byung re// rtag par bzhugs shing byin gyis rlob pa dang*// khyad par yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dus kyi tshe// mngon sum byon nas rjes su 'dzin no zhes// 'gyur med bden pa'i zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar// snying nas dad pas gsol ba 'debs lags na// da lta nyid du rjes su gzung du gsol// 'di phyi bar do rnam pa thams cad du// legs nyes skyid sdug mtho dman ci byung yang*// skyabs mgon re sa gzhan nas mi 'tshol bas// 'du 'bral med par thugs rjes rtag tu skyongs// 'khrul snang mun par 'khyams pa'i 'khor ba 'di// ye shes thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyis bsal te// ka dag bde ba chen po'i dbyings nyid du// da lta rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs// zhes dang*/

bla ma sku gsum gyi gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma sogs skabs su gang bab kyi gsol 'debs dang*/ de nas dzab bzla bar 'dod pas/ slar yang gu ru rin po che de nyid kyi thugs kar yid mig rlung gsum rtse gcig tu gtad nas byang chub ma thob bar du khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i mos gus gdung shugs drag po byas pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bu'i sna la badzra gu ru'i sngags kyi phreng ba rang sgra drag po 'u ru ru sgrogs pa nyi zer gyi rdul bzhin du bun gyis 'phros/ rang gi spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga la sogs pa'i lus kyi cha shas thams cad nas mtsho chen po la char babs pa bzhin sib sib thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad skad cig de nyid la sangs kyis dag bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ gu ru'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres par bsams la/ sems gzhan du ma yengs pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ zhes pa 'di brgya stong la sogs pa ci nus bzla/ skabs 'gar dzab dbyangs dang bcas pas rig pa bskul lo// thun grol mtshams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje bla ma drin chen chos kyi rje// padma 'byung gnas rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// gsol ba 'debs so mchog dang thun mong gi// dngos grub thams cad da lta nyid du stsol// zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ gu ru de nyid brtse ba'i spyan nam mkha'i mthongs su hrig hrig gzigs pas snang srid thams cad 'ja' 'od kyi rang bzhin du mer gyis zhu nas gu ru nyid la thim/ de nyid 'ja' dang 'od kyi rang bzhin du khra mer gyis rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas rang dang dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur nas/ gdangs 'gag pa med par 'ja' dang 'od du gsal le ba/ gshis stong nyid chos skur rjen ne ba/ ngo bo bde chen rtsol sgrub med pa'i ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par gzhag go

/mthar/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang sogs bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs spyi ltar bya'o// da lta'i dus 'dir kha ba can ljongs kyi// 'gro ba kun la rgyal ba thams cad las// ches cher byin rlabs myur ba grub pa'i rje// padma 'byung gnas zhabs dang bla ma mchog /dbyer med sgrub thabs thar lam nying khu'o// sngon tshe thub dbang zhabs sen nor bu'i 'od// gtsug gi padmor gus mchod ma ga dhā// bzang mo zhes grags byang phyogs 'dir 'ongs pa// bstan dang bla ma gtsug rgyan nor bu'i spor// 'du 'bral med par gus mchod mi'i dbang mo// gang de'i gsung gis bskul nas nyams bzhes su// padmas rjes bzung bandes sbyar ba dge/ ༈ /slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs pa thugs rje'i chu gter g.yo ba'i dri gzhon zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ au ḍi yā na'i slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas la bstod pa thugs rje'i chu gter g.yo ba'i dri bzhon zhes bya ba/ zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i ded dpon de nyid la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// e ma ho// bde chen dag pa'i zhing na 'od mtha' yas// gru 'dzin ri bo'i spor ni pad dkar 'dzin// 'dzam gling brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang po mchog /dbyer med padma 'byung gnas zhabs la 'dud// gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che// byin gyis rlobs shig tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*// phyi nang bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*// bsams pa chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// sindhū'i chu gter chen po'i klong yangs su// 'dab brgyad ze'u 'bru bzhad pa'i ge sar rtser// dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i snang brnyan ni// yid 'phrog gzhon nu'i gzugs su lhang nger snang*// gsol ba= /byin= /phyi= /bsams= /de tshe skal bzang 'byor ba'i dbang po yis// a ho bdag gi bsod nams zong gis ni// thob pa'i 'di ni srid na ngo mtshar zhes// pho brang spyan drangs sras kyi thu bor bzung*// gsol=

/byin= /phyi= /bsams= /'jig rung 'khor ba'i chu gter brtul zhugs kyi// ri dbang gis bsrubs de lta'i 'khrul 'khor las// legs par thon pa'i grub rigs zla shel dbang*// 'dzam gling dag pa'i mkha' la thogs med rgyu// gsol= /byin= /phyi= /bsams= /bka' brgyad grub pa'i gdengs can rnal 'byor las// smin grol dbang gi chu bo ma lus thob/ rdo rje'i sar bgrod slar yang de dag gi /gtsug tu bdud rtsi'i bum bzang sbyin par mdzad// gsol= /byin= /phyi= /bsams= /mkha' 'gro'i gling dang 'phags pa'i yul kun tu// paṇa grub yongs kyi gtsug gi nor bus btud// dpa' bo ḍā ki'i tshogs kyi ded dpon gyur// bdud dang mu stegs ming gi lhag mar byas// gsol= /byin= /phyi= /bsams= /khri srong lde'u btsan legs byas skya rengs kyis// legs par drangs pa'i rgyal dbang nyin byed mchog /gangs can lha yi lam du shar ba'i mod// gdug can 'byung po gnyis skyes mun khung zhum// gsol= /byin= /phyi= /bsams= /thub bstan padma'i 'dzum dkar bzhad byed cing*// gsang chen bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi nying khu yis// rje 'bangs grogs dang dkyil 'khor bco brgyad sogs// skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs kun myos par gyur// gsol= /byin= /phyi= /bsams= /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams ri klung thams cad kun// rdo rje'i zhing du byin brlabs chos nor gyi// gter kha 'bum phrag du mas gtams byas nas// kha ba ri pa'i yul ni dkar por mdzad// gsol= /byin= /phyi= /bsams= /slar yang 'dab bzang dbang po lha lam la// bgrod pa ji bzhin nyi zer la chibs nas// rnga yab dpal ri'i rtse mor yud kyis byon// rig 'dzin grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba la// gsol ba= /byin= /phyi= /bsams= /mgon po khyod kyi bden tshig bslu med gsung*// nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing*// khyad par bod kyi nyam thag 'gro ba rnams// snyigs dus sdug bsngal du mas nyen pa'i tshe// dad ldan mi re'i mdun du pad 'byung re// 'byon zhing khyad par yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dus// mngon gsum 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar// bdag dang bdag la ltos pa'i nyam thag rnams// khyod kyi zhal bzang ston ka'i zla dbang ltar// mngon sum mthong zhing mchog dang thun mong gi// dngos grub thams cad bde blag thob gyur nas// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che// byin gyis rlobs shig tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*// phyi nang bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*// bsams pa chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/

zhes au ḍi yā na'i slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di nyid rnal 'byor pa blo gsal gyis zab lung bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang sku brnyan gsung 'byon ma'i drung 'phral mar thogs med du sbyar nas phul ba dge zhing bkra shis/ yi ge pa ni mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis bgyis pa'o// ༈ /o rgyan bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ngo mtshar padma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo padma ka rā ya/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs kyi bcud// 'chi med grub pa'i dbang po mtsho skyes rje// mgon des rjes bzung blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde// snyigs dus 'dren pa zung la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// 'chi med sku brnyes dbang phyug rab brtan zhabs// nges gsang rgyud sde'i bdag po bka' 'gyur ba// snyan brgyud mnga' bdag gsum la= /ngag gi dbang phyug mkhan chen bi dza ya// grub pa'i gtsug rgyan bstan pa rab rgyas mtshan// sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga' bkra shis zhabs// mkhas grub dam pa gsum la= /smin grol gdams pa'i gter mdzod rmor chen rje// mkhas grub mtshungs med brag rtsa rdo rje 'chang*// gsang chen rigs brgya'i bdag po gnas gsar ba// rtsod dus rgyal ba gsum= /rig 'dzin chen po kun dga' rnam grol dang*// rdo rje 'chang dbang nam mkha' legs pa'i mtshan// rje btsun bla ma mkhyen rab bde chen zhabs// yongs 'dzin dam pa gsum= /zab rgyas gdams pa rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje// sku drin mtshungs med bstan pa rab rgyas zhabs// mgon des rjes bzung rtsa ba'i bla ma ste// drin chen bla ma zung la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar rang sems dad pa'i dri bzhon gyis// nyer bskul thugs rje'i sprin sngon gsar pa las// grub gnyis bdud rtsi'i char pa 'bebs bzhin du// rtsa brgyud bla mas rjes su 'dzin par shog

/snang srid dag pa rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing*// cir snang rtsa gsum kun 'dus bla ma rjer// nges pa rnyed nas rtse gcig gsol btab pas// thugs rje'i byin rlabs snying la 'jug par shog /sgra grags snyan min de rjes mi 'brang bar// grags stong dzab kyi dbyangs su 'char ba dang*// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rtog pa ci shar yang*// rang rig bla ma'i zhal bzang skyong bar shog /mdor na deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma o rgyan rjes// 'bral med rjes bzung khyod thugs ro gcig par// kun bzang gdod ma'i klong du grol bar shog /ces tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i o rgyan bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bla brgyud gsol 'debs ngo mtshar padma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni lam 'di la nyams len rtse gcig tu byed pa shā sa na dha rent+ra rā dzas yang yang bskul ba'i ngo ma chog par shākya'i dge slong mi tri karma gu ṇas sug bris su bgyis pa'o// //brgyud pa'i kha skong ni/ yongs 'dzin dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa'i mtshams/ rab 'byams smra ba bstan pa rab rgyas dang*// ngag gi dbang phyug phrin las yon tan zhabs// bka' drin mnyam med bstan 'dzin snyan grags te// rnam 'dren mtshungs med gsum la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar rang sems dad pa'i sogs dang sbrel lo// zhes pa'ang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses so// ༈ /padma 'od du skye ba'i smon tshig mi shigs thig le ma bzhugs so// mi shig bde chen thig le 'od lnga'i mdangs// 'gag med dbyings las ye shes mchog gi zer// snang stong sgyu ma'i thig phran bye ba brgya// spro dang sdud pa'i zhing mchog rnga yab gling*// mdzes sdug chu skyes 'gram par 'ja' zer gyis// 'khyud pa'i gur khyim bkra ba'i mkha' 'gro'i gnas// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag padma 'byung*// dgyes pa'i gnas der 'pho ba'i skal bzang stsol// bde chen zag pa med pa'i ye shes ros// gang thugs rnam par myos pa'i dpa' bo dang*// ḍā ki'i sprin phung gtibs pa'i do ra na// bdag kyang tshud pa'i skal ba can 'gyur shog

/ces pa 'di ni padmas rjes bzung gzims 'og thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las kyis mdzad pa'o// ༈ /dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i tshul grub gnyis 'dod 'jo'i bsam 'phel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru padma ka ra sarba siddhi pha la hoḥ ye nas ka dag chos dbyings bde chen kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas mchog /kha sbyor yan lag bdun gyi rnal rol longs sku thod phreng rigs lnga'i gar// bsam yas gdul bya'i bsam pa ji bzhin bla ma mtshan brgyad sprul pa'i sku// gcig dang du ma'i gar gyis rol pa'i rgyal dbang padma snying dbus bzhugs// mgon khyod bdag sogs ma rungs snyigs ma'i 'gro// gdul dka' lcags kyi ri bo thabs mkhas 'phrul// brgya phrag mdzad pa'i rtsi yis gser bzang por// sgyur ba'i bshes gnyen chen por bstan min nam// gang gi sku drin blo 'das bskal pa'i bar// zhing rdul snyed grangs lus srog longs spyod kyis// mchod kyang 'khor min 'on kyang tshogs zung rgyun// spel ba'i thabs tshul zab mo 'di na dge// zhes mchod par brjod nas 'dir gang bshad par bya ba ni/ rim lnga las/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i// ye shes mchog de 'thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar mdo rgyud thams cad kyi snying po/ rgya bod mkhas grub thams cad kyi nyams bzhes kyi nying khu/ tshe gcig lus gcig la zung 'jug gi sa la gshegs pa'i lam gcig pur gyur pa ni lam zab mo bla ma'i lam 'di nyid yin zhing*/ de'i phyir na dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i rim pa lag len du 'debs par byed pa la/ thog mar dus yar mar gyi tshes bcu'am/ brgyad dang bco lnga gnam stong sogs dang*/ rgyal ba'i dus chen rnams dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dus dran sogs dus khyad par can gyi tshe dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas khang sogs byi dor legs par bya/

bla bre sogs mchod rdzas ci yod bkod legs su bsham/ dkon mchog spyi dang khyad par gu ru'i sku brnyan dang rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku brnyan sogs bris 'bur gang rigs legs par bshams pa'i sku mdun ngos su stegs bu brtan cing mtho ba bang rim 'ga' zhig yod pa byas na legs shing*/ de'i steng du rten khebs sogs kyis mdzes par bkab la/ bang rim dang po la nyer spyod lnga brgya stong sogs ci 'byor/ tha ma'ang bcu las mi nyung ba dang*/ de 'og bang rim gnyis pa lta bu la gser dngul li sogs kyi maṇḍal la gling bzhi sogs bris 'bur ram/ mar thud 'bras sogs kyi tshom bu gang rigs byas la dgod/ bang rim gsum pa la tshogs rdzas kyi bye brag ci 'byor/ bang rim bzhi par bza' btung dar gos rin chen 'bru sna rol mo'i bye brag sogs rang la ci yod kyi dngos po bzang zhing rgya che ba ste yid 'khul bar bsham/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyang khrus byas/ gos gsar pa dri med gyon/ gdan yang kha gsar gyi steng du rten la kha phyogs pa'i ngos nas dga' spro dang mos dung chen pos skal ba bzang por shes bzhin du 'khod/ mdun du lcogs rtse la sogs pa'i steng du ḍa dril 'thor nas/ gzhan yang sgrub grogs kyis lcogs na rnga cha lang dung sogs kyang bsham/ 'di skabs su mchod pa'i rdzas rnams dngos po dman zhing chung ba/ grangs nyung ba/ ma dag pa/ mi gtsang ba/ snod kyang chag grum sogs bkra mi shis pa'i rigs gtan nas spang dgos te/ 'phral phug rten 'brel gyi gnad 'gags mang po'i skyon du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// cho ga dngos ni/ thog mar mchod pa rnams chab kyis bran la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs gsal dri ma med pa rnams kyi nang du oṃ yig dpag tu med pa zhu ba las byung ba'i ngo bo zag pa med pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rnam pa lha rdzas su shar ba'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ bla bre/ 'phan/ gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ lda ldi sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa kun bzang 'phags pa'i mchod sprin lta bu rtsa gsum kun 'dus bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing dge bar gyur cig oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar dang*/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi sogs lan gsum brjod cing rol mo dkrol/ de nas skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro tshar bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa brjod/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum gyis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshar gcig gis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas rten bskyed pa ni/ āḥ gdod nas spros bral stong gsal chos dbyings klong*// srid zhi'i cho 'phrul ya mtshan mtha' klas pa// ngo mtshar rten 'byung sgyu ma'i rjes 'gro'i chos// dag pa rab 'byams bkod par yongs shar ba// lnga ldan 'ja' zer drwa bas kun gsal khyon// khyab pa'i gnas 'di bde chen padma 'od// rtsa gsum rgyal pa'i pho brang nyams dga' ba// snang stong dbyer med chen por grub pa ni// lhun grub dpal gyi ri bo brjid chags steng*// lha mi'i yid bzhin nor bu las grub pa'i// rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba sogs// bkod legs pho brang sum brtsegs lta na sdug

/nyi zla'i khengs pa snyol ba'i mda' yab dang*// rgya phub rdo rje nor bu'i tog 'bar zhing*// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs chos 'khor gdugs// yid 'phrog nor bu'i rang bzhin kho nas spud// kun bzang rnam 'phrul rab 'byams mchod pa'i sprin// spro ba'i dpa' bo ḍā ki lha lha mo// gaṅgā'i rdul snyed phung pos phyi nang kun// khyab pa'i sgyu 'phrul bkod pa bsam mi khyab// khrus rdzing bdud rtsi'i chu mig lha yi shing*// 'od 'bar padma'i bye brag mtha' klas shing*// srid zhi'i phun tshogs kun dang 'ja' tshon lnga// 'dres pa'i zhing khams chen por lhun gyis grub// de lta'i gzhal med pho brang steng dbus na// kun khyab dang po'i rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ bar khang longs sku'i yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i// thod phreng rigs lnga snang stong 'od du 'bar// de 'og gzhal du med pa'i pho brang dbus// gdong lnga'i dbang pos zur bzhi rab btegs pa'i// yid bzhin bsam 'phel nor bu 'bar ba'i khri// srab 'jam lha yi reg byas spras pa'i steng*// 'jam mnyen 'dab phreng bye bas rab 'khyud pa'i/ sna tshogs chu skyes gsar pa'i lte ba la// snang byed tsha zer rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor steng*// dri bral zla ba zhun ma 'khyil pa'i dbus// skyabs gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang*// drin chen bla ma mtsho skyes sprul pa'i sku// yid 'phrog mig gi bdud rtsi dkar dmar mdangs// yongs rdzogs mtshan dpe'i mdzes rgyan kun gyis spud// phyag g.yas dregs pa zil gnon theg dgu'i rtsal// rdzogs pa'i ye shes rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin// g.yon pas mnyam gzhag dri bral ka pā la// bde chen bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams pa bsnams// thabs shes 'du 'bral med mtshon kha ṭwāṃ ga /mtshan nyid kun ldan g.yon pa'i gru mor 'dzin// mthing nag gsang phod snam sbyar le brgan mdangs// za ber smug khra'i na bza' lhab lhub g.yo// snyan rgyan mgul rgyan phyag zhabs gdu bu ni// gzi byin 'bum phrag rgyas pa nor bu'i rgyan// 'bar ba'i 'od zer bye ba dkrigs bzhin du// zhabs zung mi g.yo rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// rab mdzes she'u'i snyan zhu rdo rje dang*// rgod ldem dar sna me long gis brgyan gsol// skal bzang bdag la brtsi ba'i spyan dkyus dang*// 'grogs pa'i dgyes 'dzum ches cher ston par mdzad// chos dbyings zag med bde ba chen po dngos// snang stong ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul gang*// grangs med ḍā ki'i gtso mor rab bzhengs pa'i// bde skyong rnam gnyis sgeg mdzes rjes chags ngoms// mtha' skor kun tu bla ma yi dam sogs// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs sprin bzhin 'khrigs// khyad par bla ma mtshan brgyad sgrub chen brgyad// rgya bod rig 'dzin brgyad sogs rje 'bangs tshogs// dam can srung ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i rdul// phyi nang kun tu khyab pa'i bar mtshams nas// gtum rngams drag pos bdud 'dul las bzhi'i ging*// dpag med 'phro 'du chu zla'i rol pas bzhugs// zhes bskyed cing gsal legs par btab la/

de nas ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ de ltar skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma de'i// gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing nag /rnyogs bral dwangs mtsho'i gzugs brnyan ji bzhin pa// khyad par thugs kar zla steng yi ge hrīḥ /de las 'od zer dbang mdog lcags kyu'i dbyibs// grangs med glog gi pho nya'i ngang tshul can// o rgyan zangs mdog dpal ri la sogs pa// phyogs bcu dag pa rab 'byams zhing khyab pas// bla ma bde gshegs yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// sangs rgyas byang sems dam can srung ma'i tshogs// phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun nas sprin phung bzhin/ skad cig nyid la badzra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams// padma ge sar sdong po la// ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags// 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor// khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi// byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol// ma lus sems can sogs nas/ yang dag 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes pa'i bar brjod nas ye shes pa spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gnyis med thim pas 'dren mchog chos kyi rje// ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gtso// skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur// ces brjod pa'i rjes su/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pas gtso mdzad skyabs yul rnams mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa'i drung du/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad re re'ang lus zhing gi rdul snyed dang mnyam par sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po dang ldan pas yan lag lnga sa la gtugs te phyag 'tshal bzhin du/ gang gi drin gyis zag med bde chen mchog /skad cig dran pa'i mod la sbyin mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje sems// khyod zhabs gtsug gi nor bu rtag tu bsten// rab mdzes mtshan dpe'i nyi ma brgya phrag gi// dpal 'bar sku yi snang ba dran pa'i mod// srid pa'i mun pa drung nas 'byin mdzad pa'i// rje btsun snang ba'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mos khams bsam pa dang*// mthun pa'i zab gsang chos 'khor tshangs pa'i dbyangs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor rtag 'bab pa'i// rje btsun gsung gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// dus gsum gzigs pa'i ye shes chags thogs dang*// bral ba rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs// srid zhi yongs la snyoms pa'i bdag nyid can// rje btsun dran pas gdung sel la=

/stobs bcu mi 'jigs dran nye sangs rgyas chos// yongs rdzogs spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs// bsam yas yon tan rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid can// rje btsun yid bzhin re skong la= /zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam bzhi'i mthu// nam mkha' ji srid gnas bar sems can la// rgyun mi chad par ston pa'i mgon gcig pu// rje btsun snying rje'i dbang phyug= /'khor ba'i lam du dug gsum rkyen drag pos// bslangs pa'i duḥkha'i tshor ba mi bzad pa// sdug bsngal gsum gyi nad las grol mdzad pa'i// rje btsun sman gyi bla ma la= /dug lnga'i nags rum log lta'i gcong rong dang*// the tshom sha za le lo'i chom rkun gyis// nyam thag rgyud lnga'i mgron po skyob mdzad pa'i// rje btsun sprul pa'i sku mchog la= /khyod mtshan dran pa'i mod la thar pa'i dgra// rab 'jigs bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal te// bde chen zhi ba'i gnas su bkri mdzad pa'i// rje btsun mthu stobs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// bdag dang khams gsum mar gyur mtha' yas kun// bslu med mgon po khyod las gzhan pa'i skyabs// nam yang ma mchis sgo gsum mi phyed pas// snying khong rus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// rje btsun bla ma khyed dang mi 'bral zhing*// brtse bas rjes bzung khyod mnyes bgyid thob nas// mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// ces dang gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma dang*/ khyad par rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku bstod brgya tshar sogs ci nus 'don/ de nas dad 'dun gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas 'di ltar gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ stobs bcu'i ye shes nyi ma 'bum phrag brgyar// 'bar ba'i gzi byin srid gsum khyon na bzhad// gar gyi dbang phyug bde gshegs thod phreng rtsal// dkyil 'khor bye ba'i bdag po khyod la 'dud// gzhal med thugs rje'i 'od zhags ring po'i 'phrul// grangs med 'gro la rjes brtses dam 'khyud pa'i// zla med ston pa rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// bar med yid la dran no thugs rjes skyongs// thog med dus kyi mdza' bo rmongs mun gyis// mi bzad srid lam ring por 'khrid pa'i mgron// duḥkha'i rba klong 'khrugs pa'i 'khor mtsho las// sgrol ba'i ded dpon mdzad dus deng kho na// rnam gsum shes rab gsal ba'i mig ldongs shing*// 'jigs rung rtag chad lta ba'i g.yang sar 'phyan// thar pa'i sa mkhan bral ba'i mgon med rnams// mgon khyod thugs rjes gtong ba phod lags sam// gnyis snang 'gro la sdang ba'i me lce yis// dge tshogs nags klung bsregs pa'i 'bras bu che// tsha grang dmyal ba'i yul na spyod pa rnams// myur du mi skyob yal bar 'dor ram ci// rgya chen bsod nams tshogs kyi yan lag rnams// sred pa'i lcags kyis 'khyud pa'i ser sna'i sgrog

/dam pos bcings 'bras bkres skom yi dwags lus// khyod kyis mi skyob lus can su la re// phan bde'i pad rtsa rtsad nas 'joms byed pa'i// gti mug glang chen myos pa'i sna zhags kyis// glen lkugs dud 'gror 'phangs pa'i 'gro 'di dag /skyabs gzhan ma mchis brtse ba'i phyag gis drongs// rlabs chen gzhan phan bsam sbyor dag pa'i srog /mi srun phrag dog rnon po'i mtshon cha yis// bkums pa'i rang gzugs lha min 'thab rtsod las// myur du skyob par mdzod cig mkhyen brtse'i gter// dad sogs 'phags nor rin chen bdun gyi nor// nga rgyal mi srun chom rkun sde tshogs kyis// bcom 'bras tshe ring 'pho ltung lha'i sdug bsngal// mtha' dag zhi bar mdzod cig thugs rje'i dbang*// mtha' bral rnam dag lta ba'i snang 'od gang*// log lta'i smag rum stug pos bsgribs pa'i mthus// mtha' 'khob kla klo mi lus tsam po'i 'bras// ma lus zhi bar mdzod cig lha yi lha// ring nas zhi ba'i lam las phyir gyur cing*// 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon nyam nga bar// 'phyan pa'i bdag cag mar gyur ltos bcas kun// mgon po khyed kyis yal bar mi 'dor gsol// kye ma kye ma rgyal dbang thugs rje'i bdag /mtsho skyes rdo rje da dung dgongs su gsol// snyigs ma'i mtha' dus mgon khyod thugs rje'i rtsal// che bar rdo rje'i bka' yis ma 'ches sam// 'khor bas nyam nyes gyur ba'i 'gro ba la// rgyal ba'i ye shes gzigs pa mi 'jug na// zhi ba bla med myang 'das sar zhugs tshe// bde gshegs rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i bya byed bral// de phyir bdag dang ma gyur 'gro ba rnams// 'khor ba'i 'dam nas thugs rje'i phyag gis drongs// bde chen rnga yab padma 'od zhing du// rig 'dzin ḍā ki'i gral du tshud par shog /ces gsol ba btab la/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni gong du song ba bzhin byas la/

tshigs bcad kyi dus lag pa snying gar thal mo sbyar/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar pad kor dang rang rang gi phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas pa bya zhing*/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab rgyas shing*// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla ma mchod// oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ zhabs bsil phal cher dang*/ pā dyaṃ/ me tog dang*/ puṣpe/ bdug spos dang*/ dhū pe/ snang gsal dang*/ ā lo ke/ dri chab dang*/ gandhe/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wi dya/ rol mo phal cher dang*/ oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra shabda pra tītstsha pū dza ma gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes dang rol mo bya zhing*/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha wi ta/ badzra dharmā hṛ da ya/ santo ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ho ho ho/ ā khaṃ swā hā/ de nas rgyas shing spros pa la dga' na rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa'ang bya ste/ rang gi snying ga nas rig ma bcu drug dpag tu med pa spros la/ de rnams kyis bla ma 'khor bcas mchod par bsam zhing so so'i phyag rgya rnams byas la/ dbang sngon mdog mtshungs rdo rje pi waṃ ma// sna tshogs rgyan dang gos kyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas// dpal ldan bla ma pi waṃ sgra yis mchod// oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra wī ṇi

'di la sgra brnyan bsgyur tshul byed/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ de bzhin du tshig rkang bar pa gnyis thams cad la 'dra bar sbyar la/ gser bzang mdog mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma// sna tshogs gos dang= /nam mkha' gang bar= /dpa' ldan bla ma gling bu'i sgra= /oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra thams cad la sbyar te/ oṃ badzra baṃ se hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad rāg mdog mtshungs rdo rje rdza rnga ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'i= /dpal ldan bla ma rdza rnga'i sgra= /oṃ badzra mṛ daṃ 'di la rnga sbo logs nas rdung du tshul byed/ ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga zlum ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dpal ldan bla ma rnga zlum sgra= /oṃ badzra mu ra dze 'di la rnga steng nas rdung tshul byed/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ li khri'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje bzhad pa ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dpal ldan bla ma bzhad pa'i bde bas mchod// oṃ badzra hā sya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje sgeg pa mo// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dpal ldan bla ma sgeg mdzes bde bas mchod// oṃ badzra lā sya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gur gum mdog mtshungs rdo rje glu len ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dpal ldan bla ma snyan pa'i glu yis mchod// oṃ badzra gīrti hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pri yang mdog mtshungs rdo rje gar mkhan ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dpal ldan bla ma mdzes pa'i gar gyis mchod// oṃ badzra nīrti hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zla ba'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje me tog ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dpal ldan bla ma me tog sil mas mchod// oṃ badzra puṣpe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ind+ra nī la'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dpal ldan bla ma bdug spos sprin gyis mchod// oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyi ma'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje mar me ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dpal ldan bla ma mar me'i phreng bas mchod// oṃ badzra dī paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

sindhū'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje dri chab ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dpal ldan bla ma dri bzang byugs pas mchod// oṃ badzra gandhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu shel mdog mtshungs gzugs kyi rdo rje ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= dpal ldan bla ma gzugs kyi bde bas mchod// oṃ rū pa badzrī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ btsod kyi mdog mtshungs ro yi rdo rje ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dpal ldan bla ma ro yi bde bas mchod// oṃ ra sa badzrī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sna tshogs mdog mtshungs reg bya'i rdo rje ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dpal ldan bla ma reg bya'i bde bas mchod// oṃ sparshe badzrī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ston zla'i mdog mtshungs chos dbyings rdo rje ma// sna tshogs= /nam mkha'= /dpal ldan bla ma chos khams bde bas mchod// oṃ dharmā 'di la nor bu mig gsum pa'i phyag rgya byed dhā tu badzrī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥs rin chen sna bdun sprul la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun chad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra tsakra ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren cing phongs pa rgyun chad de// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /sngar gyi sngags kyi rjes su/ ma ṇi ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pa sogs rigs 'gre/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wasti ratna= /blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog

/ma hā ta ratna= glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal zhing*// bla med theg par rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti ratna/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar shog /tu raṃ ga a shwa ratna= dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// snyems bral mchog ni thob par shog /khaṅga ratna= de nas 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru buddha bo ddhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams// mos blos bla ma mchog la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// shabda/ phyogs dus kun na tsandan sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// mos blos bla ma= /bzhes shig bla med= /gandhe/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig= /ra sa/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig= /sparshe/ zhes pas mchod/ de nas tshogs rdzas rnams chab kyis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo sogs lan gsum dang*/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan zhing nas/ 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog gi bar lan gsum gyis phul te/ de nas/ dman pa'i yul las sogs kyis sman rag yod na'ang 'bul/

de yan chad phyi mchod do// de nas/ rang rig don gyi phag mo gri thod can// tshangs bug nas thon srid pa'i gzugs phung de'i// thod pa mdun gyi gzhi der legs bkod pas// stong gsum khyab pa'i yol go chen por gyur// tshigs chen bcu gnyis stod smad nang khrol dang*// mgo bo'i lhag bcas dum bur snod der bskyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥs ye shes kyi// bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro phun tshogs gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ āḥ kun khyab dang po'i rgyal ba snang mtha' yas// gsang chen ston pa longs sku thod phreng lnga// sprul pa'i sku mchog bla ma mtshan brgyad la// zag med bdud rtsis mchod do grub gnyis stsol// ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ sku bzhi'i ngo bo ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid// yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i 'dren pa mchog /sku drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// zag med bdud rtsis= /ma hā= 'di tshar bdun lnga gsum tsam 'bul/ rgya bod rig 'dzin bla ma ji snyed dang*// khyad par dbang lung man ngag zab mo'i chos// nos pa'i dngos brgyud bla ma thams cad la// zag med= /ma hā= sgrub chen brgyad sogs yi dam zhi khro'i lha// dam can srung ma dpa' bo ḍā ki'i tshogs// gnod sbyin nor lha dkar skyong lha klu la// zag med= ma hā= thog med dus nas ma gyur 'gro rnams dang*// bgegs rigs gdon sogs lan chags sha gnyer kun// zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud 'dis tshim gyur te// zhi ba bla med byang sems ldan gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas nang mchod phul/ rang sems phag mo'i rnam 'phrul mtshar sdug can// bcu drug lang tsho'i nyams ldan yid 'phrog mar// mnyam sbyor bde chen dga' bzhi'i mchod pa ches// drin chen bla ma mchod do grub gnyis stsol// zhes gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod/ de nas/ mchod bya mchod byed ji snyed mchod pa'i rdzas// rten 'brel sgyu ma'i rol mo tha dad kyang*// don dam dbyer med ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang*// brjod bral blo 'das chen po'i dbyings su thim// zhes brjod la ji tsam gnas kyi bar mnyam par 'jog pa ni de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// de nas maṇḍal 'bul ba'i tshul ni/

rgyan sum cu so bdun rin po che las grub pa'am mar thud las bzos pa bkod kyang rung ste/ mchod g.yog pas lag pa g.yon pas maṇḍal bzung*/ g.yas pas spos rengs thogs te/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐ sogs tshom bu so bdun ma/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gang gi mchod rdzas sogs nas mnyes gyur cig deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// sogs nas/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra ratna maṇḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas maṇḍal phul/ de nas sdig bshags sogs bya ba ni/ oṃ/ ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni// zla rgyas bzhin du spros pa mi mnga' yang*// thugs rjes nyi gsal 'od bzhin snyoms mdzad pa// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol// brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku// bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso// thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya cher rol pa yi// zhi khro sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis// mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya cher yongs bkod de// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod// kun tu bzang mo gsang ba'i bha ga la// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus kun// 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du ro gcig pa'i// gnyis med byang chub sems kyis mnyes gyur cig /sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che// chos rnams rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal zhing*// rnal 'byor nyid dbyings smra bsams las 'das pa// mnyam nyid byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dud/

āḥ kun bzang rdzogs chen ye nas gdal ba la// phyi nang gsang ba bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni// snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i dbyings// byung dang 'byung 'gyur yab yum lhun rdzogs rnams// gsang chen rab dgyes gzungs chen bdag nyid ma// mkha' dbyings klong yangs padmor 'khyil ba ni// gnyis med thig le chen por 'od gsal ba// ma bcos spros med byang chub snying po'i sku// cir yang snang ba bde chen g.yung drung lha// 'du 'bral med pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag nyid chen po rigs lnga yab yum dang*// byang chub lcam dral khro bo khro mo'i tshogs// rdo rje lha mo tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag /rigs lnga dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu// gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya sgo ma bzhi// ye shes sprul ba'i lha tshogs mang po rnams// ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung la sogs// legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i// phyi nang mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs// dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol/ hūm̐/ thugs rje'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor bdag cag gis// 'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems bskyed de// bla med go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir// bstan pa rgya mtsho so so'i 'dul khrims dang*// sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor sdom pa'i mchog /rdo rje 'da' dka' dam tshig gtan gyi gnyer// spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams// snga phyir mnos shing gnyer du smras so 'tshal// yun du mi gtong 'da' bar mi bgyid la// don la gol zhing ldog sems ma mchis kyang*// gdod bya long yod snyam pa'i le lo yis// klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs chung ba dang*// shes bzhin mi ldan bag med dbang gyur te// sgom la mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba sogs// tshor dang ma tshor ma rig dbang gis ni// ston pa'i bka' dang dam las 'gal gyur te// rnal 'byor gang zhig dam tshig nyams pa dang*// skad cig tsam yang phrad par mi bya zhes// bka' las byung zhing de ltar ma lcogs te// gsang sgo 'chol bas dbye bsal dka' ba las// mngon shes chung bas skyon can ma rtogs te// nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyams pa bskang ba dang*// nyams dang snod min rnams la chos bshad dang*// nyams la mi 'dzems nyams pa'i skyon la sogs// nyams dang 'grogs shing nyams pa de dag gi// nyams grib skyon gyis gos par gyur to 'tshal// tshe 'di'i rkyen dang yun gyi sgrib pa rnams// rang gnod 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// byams pa'i thugs kyis bdag la dgongs nas kyang*// gnyis med dbyings su mi 'gyur bdag bkod de// mi dmigs btang snyoms ngang du bzhugs nas kyang*// gnyis med don gyi tshangs pa stsal du gsol// don dam gnyis med spros dang bral ba la// rnam rtog gang yang dmigs par mi 'gyur te// kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi dbang gis ni// nongs pa mchis rnams rab gnong bzod par gsol// zhes dang*/

rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi spyan lam du// yo byad 'byor tshogs chung ba mthol lo bshags// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du// mngon rtogs spong len bgyis ba mthol= /mkha' 'gro sde bzhi rnams kyi spyan= /khas blangs dam bca' nyams pa= /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi spyan= /gtor ma lo zlar 'gyangs pa= /dus gsum pha ma rnams kyi spyan= /drin la lan gyis ma lon= /mched dang lcam dral rnams kyi spyan= /dam tshig brtse gdung chung ba= /'gro drug sems can rnams kyi spyan= /snying rje phan sems chung ba mthol lo bshags// so sor thar pa rnams kyi sdom pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa dang*// rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi dam tshig sogs// nyams pa thams cad mthol bshags mi 'chab bo// mi sbed lhan chad gcod cing sdom par bgyid// dus gsum byas bsags sdig sgrib mthol bshags na// tshangs par mdzad nas sku gsung thugs la sogs// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// de nas yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni/ bdag cag rnams kyis thog med dus nas ni// da lta'i bar du sgo gsum mi dge'i las// ji snyed bgyis kun shin tu gnong 'gyod kyi// gdung ba drag po'i yid kyis mthol zhing bshags// mgon po khyod kyi phrin las rmad byung dang*// srid zhi'i dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rangs// bla med rgyal ba sras bcas khyed rnams kyis// rtag par chos 'khor rgya chen bskor du gsol// sems can yongs kyis zhi ba'i go 'phang mchog /thob min de srid mya ngan mi 'dar mdzod// nam yang bslu med bla ma mchog gsum la// bdag cag byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyi don phyir du// byang chub dam pa mchog der sems bskyed cing*// dus gsum dge tshogs ji snyed mchis so cog /ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la rtag tu bsngo// sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang sogs brjod la/

de nas dbang blang ba ni/ dpal ldan rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can// sku dang ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje 'chang*// mgon khyod bdag la brtse bas rab dgongs la// bde chen dbang bzhi da lta bskur du gsol// zhes rtse gcig tu gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ de nas/ phyi nang mtha' skor bzhugs pa'i rten brten pa// ma lus 'od zhu rtsa ba'i bla mar thim// skyabs gsum kun 'dus mgon des bdag nyid la// dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur dpag med ston bzhin du// dpral ba'i oṃ las 'phros pa'i 'od dkar po// grangs med spyi bor zhugs pas lus kyi nang*// yongs gang sgrib byang bum pa'i dbang bskur thob// bskyed rim la dbang sprul sku'i rten 'brel 'grigs// bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar po// grangs med mgrin par zhugs pas lus kun khyab// ngag gi sgrib byang gsang ba'i dbang bskur thob// rdzogs rim la dbang longs sku'i rten 'brel 'grigs// bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od mthing ga /bdag gi snying gar zhugs te lus kun khyab// yid kyi sgrib byang sher dbang legs thob ste// thig le sgom dbang chos sku'i rten 'brel 'grigs// slar yang bla ma'i gnas gsum sa bon las// 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'ja' tshon ltar// spros te bdag gi dpral mgrin snying ga'i lam// legs brgyud lus kun dbang gzhu'i mdangs kyis khyab// sgo gsum sgrib pa ma lus yongs dag cing*// bzhi pa'i dbang thob rdzogs chen ye shes che// sgom par dbang zhing ngo bo nyid kyi sku// 'grub pa'i rten 'brel tha dag 'grigs par gyur// ces pas dbang blangs la/ de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab pa ni/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus pa'i// gsang ba gsum bdag dpal ldan he ru ka /rje btsun thugs rje'i dbang phyug zhabs pad la// rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// gang gi sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs mu med pas// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi// sgo gsum ye shes chen por byin gyis rlobs// sngon las 'phral rkyen gyis bskyed mi mi min// 'byung po'i gdon sogs nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing*// tshe dpal bsod nams dbang phyug longs spyod sogs// phun tshogs dpal gyis 'tsho bar byin=

/chos brgyad mtshan 'dzin srid pa 'khor ba'i chos// gzhan don 'dor dang myang 'das mthar ltung sogs// dam pas smad pa'i bsam sbyor ji snyed pa// nam yang skye ba med par byin= /sems nyid las rung bag yod dran shes ldan// tshul khrims dam tshig sdom pa rnam par dag /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma phra mos kyang*// nam yang gos pa med par byin= /dad brtson shes rab snying rje phun tshogs ldan// gzhan phan byang chub sems gnyis zung du chud// lung rtogs chos kyi nor bus rgyud phyug ste// bla med rtogs pa skye bar byin= /nam zhig 'jig rten 'di nas 'pho ba'i tshe// 'dir snang la yang chags zhen dang bral zhing*// lus sems zug rngu las grol dga' bde'i yid// rang gsal ting 'dzin ldan par byin gyis rlobs// khyad par mgon khyod mchog gsum yi dam lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs// mngon sum sprin lam las byon bdag bsus te// 'jigs rung bar do'i g.yul las bsgral du gsol// bde chen zhi ba'i grong khyer nyams dga' bar// skyabs mchog bla ma'i zhabs pad gus bsten cing*// gsung gi bdud rtsis sems rgyud yongs grol te// stobs bcu'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid dgyes bzhin du 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas rang gi
